sentences.text: Rinconraptor is a megaraptorid theropod dinosaur, a member of the family Megaraptoridae.
This animal belongs to the class Reptilia.
The only known species in this genus is Rinconraptor pipoae.
Méndez and colleagues established the new genus and species in 2026, publishing their work in Palaeontologia Electronica.
The team included Ariel H. Méndez and Ariana Paulina-Carabajal.
Fossils were found in Argentina at the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
Rinconraptor lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian age of the Late Cretaceous.
The Bajo de la Carpa Formation consists of sandstone and muddy sediments representing fluvial and aeolian systems.
The paleoenvironment was semi-arid and supported a diverse ecosystem including turtles, crocodyliforms, ornithopods, abelisaurids, and other megaraptorans.
